retrievalProfile.description: A dual-portrait composition featuring two figures in western attire against a deep blue sky and cracked desert floor, anchored by a central longhorn skull icon and heavy serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical yet dynamic composition featuring two men in the foreground—one in a cowboy hat and black shirt, the other in sunglasses and a leather jacket—separated by a vast desert landscape that recedes into a deep blue sky. A stylized white longhorn skull sits centrally at the top, overlapping large, textured serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground figures framing a distant horizon
Textured typography integrated with a central icon
High contrast between the deep blue sky and warm desert earth
Symmetrical placement of subjects creating a balanced duo dynamic
coreInvariants: Cracked earth texture in the bottom third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two medium-shot figures positioned on the left and right thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white longhorn skull at the top center serves as the primary focal point for the branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central skull, move outward to the large text, then down to the two main figures, finally settling on the small silhouettes in the distant center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast blue sky between the two figures provides significant breathing room for the central icon and distant horizon.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky contrasts with the desaturated, dusty tones of the foreground clothing and earth.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with western proportions
letterConstructionRules: Diamond-shaped decorative motifs within letter stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is scaled down and nested between the primary words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face paired with a graphic icon.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic western woodblock aesthetic
Strong verticality and western slab serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a desert landscape with a cracked mud floor in the foreground and a deep blue sky. Place two men in western attire (one with a cowboy hat, one with sunglasses and leather jacket) on the left and right sides. Include two tiny silhouettes of men with guitars in the far distance center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, weathered slab-serif title at the top center in a copper-brown color. Overlay a stark white longhorn skull silhouette directly over the center of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the longhorn skull pure white and centered?
Does the text have a distressed, western texture?
Is the horizon line low, emphasizing the sky?
Are the two main figures framing the center?

adjustableVariables: Amount of cracking in the desert floor
Scale of the central skull icon
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the skull icon does not obscure legibility of the text
Verify the cracked earth texture is visible in the foreground
Check that the blue sky has a smooth gradient
Confirm the figures are in medium-shot crop
recipe.reuseFormula: Western Duo = (Symmetrical Foreground Portraits + Deep Blue Sky) / (Weathered Slab Serif + Central Animal Icon) * Cracked Earth Texture
